messages: Support check failed: the claim that ‘Nance’s counsel contends that Georgia law separates the death sentence from the method of execution, citing Dawson v. State’ is not backed by any evidence with that attribution; the only evidence referencing Dawson is an argument by Mr. Hellman, not the petitioner.

Attribution check failed: the same claim incorrectly attributes the Dawson v. State citation to the ‘Petitioner’; the source evidence attributes it to Mr. Hellman (party argument), so the attribution is inaccurate.
